scope: Finite observable-algebra audit. Sections package Q-side free-bit values across four trace sectors only to test possible intrinsic relations; AP3G itself has not declared such a global section or relation. No external time, physical dynamics, or public record law is modeled.

observable_algebra_cases.A_local: Only local trace labels, local valuation legality, and local Q coordinates; no I_s,t.
observable_algebra_cases.A_relational: Adds pairwise I_s,t=d(s) xor d(t) cross-sector observables.

relative_signature_observable.definition: I_(00,s) for the three non-reference sectors

AP3G_status: AP3G supplies local context valuations and constraints, but no global four-sector Q-bit section, cross-sector I_s,t observables, or valuation-bit gauge action.
plentitude_typing_note: Only if non-gauge lift/orbit structures are explicitly typed as genuine admissible aspects does conditional plenitude co-realize them. This audit does not make that typing assignment.
restricted_conclusion: If only fibre-local valuation structure is intrinsic, full sector-dependent Q-bit redefinitions can be candidate gauge and all sections/lifts form one description class. If cross-sector relative-bit observables are intrinsic, full redefinitions change content while uniform complement remains candidate gauge, giving eight classes. Current AP3G does not contain the observable algebra needed to choose.
